Name: Gus Dialogue - Restored 'player name' mentions
Author: Alexsir94
Description:
This is a very very simple (.xnb) mod and probably largely redundant if you use lots of other mods, but if you want something very simple and vanilla to cheat through here you go. 

Changes the dialogue (.xnb) of Gus.
[i]Not compatible with other mods that changes the dialogue of Gus.[/i]


In the tavern Gus used to @ the players name repeatedly, spammably.

@ mentions could be exploited because if you had named yourself after an item code you would receive whatever the corresponding item was when someone mentioned your name. Example naming yourself "[74]" would give you a "Prismatic Shard".

[i]
[/i]


Install [Manual]:
- Unzip or extract the folder after download
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files, in this folder go to > Content > Characters > Dialogue
- Replace Gus.xnb

(Remember to backup your original Gus.xnb first in case you want to revert or experience any issues)


[i]
[/i]
Changes:
To:
        "Saloon": "Good evening. Can I get you anything @?",
        "Saloon4": "Good evening. Make yourself at home @.",
        "Saloon_Thu": "Hey, @ looks like you could use a beverage.",
From:
        "Saloon": "Good evening. Can I get you anything?",
        "Saloon4": "Good evening. Make yourself at home.",
        "Saloon_Thu": "Hey, you look like you could use a beverage.",
